name: TDR Limiter 6 GE
notes: Probed 2026-11-23: values are 0-1 positions, read through a table measured with tools/build-table.mjs.

Only the compressor module is mapped: threshold, ratio, attack and release (ms, scale 0.001 makes them seconds), its gain as make-up, and Compressor Enabled as in/out. The peak limiter, HF limiter, clipper and output stages come back as you left them.
